cases.purpose: Fetch signed repository artifacts over a bounded, independently controlled loopback HTTP peer.
cases.oracle: Independent OpenSSL-signed per-architecture INDEX and package fixtures served by a VM-guarded loopback-only HTTP peer. A separate Python HTTP client first verifies exact signed index, signature, package, and package-signature bytes served. The evaluator enforces a fresh network namespace containing only loopback.
cases.comparison: Require successful remote pkg fetch, exact mirrored package and signature bytes, and raw server evidence that the candidate requested the signed index and both artifacts; preserve independent signature controls and HTTP request records.

files.inner.sh:
export BASHSIGNIFY_TRUSTED_KEYS_DIR="$HOME/pkg-fixture/trusted" BASHSIGNIFY_REVOKED_KEYS="$HOME/pkg-fixture/not-revoked"
F="$HOME/pkg-fixture"; ARCH=$(/usr/bin/uname -m)
builtin pkg fetch --root root --sources "$HOME/http-sources.list" --timeout 4 > "$HOME/first.out" 2> "$HOME/first.err"
printf 'fetch=%s\n' "$?"
/usr/bin/cmp -s "$F/v2.pkg" "root/var/lib/pkg/repos/repository/$ARCH/fixtureprobe-2.pkg" && /usr/bin/cmp -s "$F/v2.pkg.sig" "root/var/lib/pkg/repos/repository/$ARCH/fixtureprobe-2.pkg.sig" && printf 'artifacts=exact\n' || printf 'artifacts=missing\n'
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/transfer-repository-r2.py capture-after > "$HOME/repository-capture.out" 2> "$HOME/repository-capture.err" || exit 97

cases.candidate_script:
export PATH=/usr/bin:/bin BASHSIGNIFY_TRUSTED_KEYS_DIR="$HOME/pkg-fixture/trusted" BASHSIGNIFY_REVOKED_KEYS="$HOME/pkg-fixture/not-revoked"
HTTP=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/transfer-repo-http-r2.py
port=; peer=
cleanup_http() {
    saved=$?
    trap - EXIT
    if [[ -n $peer ]]; then
        if [[ -n $port ]]; then /usr/bin/python3 "$HTTP" stop "$port" >> "$HOME/repo-http-stop.out" 2>> "$HOME/repo-http-stop.err" || :; fi
        wait "$peer" 2>/dev/null || :
    fi
    return "$saved"
}
trap cleanup_http EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 "$HTTP" serve > "$HOME/repo-http-peer.out" 2> "$HOME/repo-http-peer.err" &
peer=$!
for ((i=0;i<80;i++)); do [[ -s "$HOME/repo-http-port" ]] && break; /bin/sleep 0.05; done
[[ -s "$HOME/repo-http-port" ]] || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED HTTP listen'; exit 98; }
port=$(<"$HOME/repo-http-port")
/usr/bin/python3 "$HTTP" control "$port" > "$HOME/repo-http-control.out" 2> "$HOME/repo-http-control.err" || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED independent HTTP retrieval'; exit 98; }
printf 'http://127.0.0.1:%s/repository\n' "$port" > "$HOME/http-sources.list"
/usr/bin/timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=3s 24s "$BASH" --noprofile --norc "$PWD/inner.sh"
inner_rc=$?
/usr/bin/python3 "$HTTP" stop "$port" > "$HOME/repo-http-stop.out" 2> "$HOME/repo-http-stop.err"; stop_rc=$?
wait "$peer"; peer_rc=$?; peer=
trap - EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 - "$inner_rc" "$stop_rc" "$peer_rc" <<'PYH'
import json,pathlib,platform,sys
p=pathlib.Path('/tmp/parity-home'); e=[json.loads(x) for x in (p/'repo-http-events.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
r=json.loads((p/'repo-http-result.json').read_text()); a=platform.machine(); base='/repository/'+a+'/'
needed={base+x for x in ('INDEX','INDEX.sig','fixtureprobe-2.pkg','fixtureprobe-2.pkg.sig')}
observed={x['path'] for x in e if not x['control'] and x['method']=='GET' and x['status']==200 and x['peer']=='127.0.0.1'}
valid=needed <= observed and r['stopped'] and r['error'] is None and sys.argv[1:] == ['0','0','0']
print('http-peer=observed' if valid else 'http-peer=unobserved')
PYH
